findings: Optional Settings.close_retry_timeout_ms defaults0. Infinite is rejected. take_settings exchanges donor to0; field added at end, all Settings/Snapshot consumers require rebuild. WaitingClose appended to Phase without renumbering old values.

Proxy retries only destroy_pending_socket after typed QuiescenceDeferred. It keeps the original call stack and whole Pending/Graph/Inputs/Resources/TLS alive; wait_close_retry rechecks same worker/fiber/PTD and exact Graph/backend known-deferral state before waiting outside Parent.

WaitingClose publishes nonzero monotonically increasing epoch under Worker gate. Only retry_close(current_epoch) on original controller/fiber sets one coalesced requested flag and event. Zero/stale/nonwaiting calls deny; startup/stop event signals cannot authorize retry. No opaque callback under Worker gate.

One finite wait budget starts at first known false drain and spans repeated waits/rechecks. Deadline checked before accepting a requested retry. Timeout, unknown exception, invalid state/PTD or explicit poison retain attempt through existing run_server catch; no guessed cleanup or source restart.

Five isolated scenario sources: normal two false/epoch1/epoch2 then true with exact actor/PTD and one source start; timeout821, disabled822, opaque typed exception823 and poisoned wait824. Normal scenario includes foreign controller denial, stale/zero/future epochs, stop/startup spurious wakes and actual native/FLS join before controller finish.

Only worker.hpp/worker.cpp and worker_tests.cpp changed. Prior Graph/server correction unchanged. Policy is selected in synthetic test source only; no production controller stop/join binding or early-stop receipt-drain implementation added.
